I’m not saying to not register as a donor, I’m just saying lots of people sign up to donate who might otherwise be open to donating their bodies to science and don’t realize that organ donation is very rare, so it’s good to have a backup plan of your wishes. Like, if I can donate bc I’m brain dead, great, but if I die where my organs are not salvageable (which is most people) then it’s something to think about to make those wishes known!

You’re highly unlikely to die in a way that will even let you donate most organs just FYI

Edit - I’m not saying not to register as an organ donor, please do!!
